additional_conditions: Access Sheffield scheme provides reduced offers to eligible students based on personal circumstances.
document_text: Sheffield Access Sheffield offer is a reduced entry offer for students from underrepresented backgrounds. Eligible students receive lower grade requirements across all qualification types. For A levels the Access Sheffield offer is AAB or ABB compared to the standard A*AA or AAA. Students should check eligibility on the Sheffield website.

additional_conditions: Applies to EPQ on relevant topic, Core Maths qualifications, or A/AS level Further Maths taken alongside standard Level 3 programme.
document_text: Sheffield offers 1 grade reduction for CS students taking additional qualifications alongside their standard Level 3 programme. This applies to: EPQ on a topic relevant to the degree (must achieve a specific grade); Core Maths qualifications including AQA Mathematical Studies, OCR Core Maths A or B, or Pearson Mathematics in Context; or A level or AS level Further Maths. Sheffield identifies eligibility automatically from the UCAS application - no separate notification needed.

headline_grade: Up to 3 grades below standard offer
additional_conditions: CS courses are A*AA standard - up to 3 grades reduction brings offer to AAB/ABB level. Must have home fee status. Sheffield Firm choice required to benefit at results stage.
document_text: Sheffield Access+ scheme offers CS students up to 3 grades below the standard A*AA offer, bringing the offer down to AAB or ABB level. Eligible groups include: residents of IMD Quintile 1 or 2 deprived areas; students entitled to free school meals; care experienced students; care leavers; carers; students estranged from family; students with parenting responsibilities; and forced migrants (asylum seekers, refugees, humanitarian protection). Sheffield identifies most eligibility automatically from UCAS - students must make Sheffield their Firm choice to benefit at results stage. Home fee status required.

additional_conditions: IMD 2019 Quintile 1 or 2. Postcode checked automatically via UCAS. No action needed from student.
document_text: Sheffield Access+ deprivation eligibility is based on the Government Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD 2019). Students living in a neighbourhood assessed as IMD Quintile 1 or 2 (most deprived areas) are eligible for up to 2 grades reduction, or up to 3 grades for A*AA CS courses. Sheffield receives postcode information directly from UCAS and assesses eligibility automatically - students do not need to do anything.

headline_grade: Up to 3 grades below standard offer
additional_conditions: Must successfully complete programme. Home fee status required. Sheffield academic selectors automatically aware of participation.
document_text: Sheffield offers up to 3 grades reduction for CS students who have participated in widening access programmes including: Realising Opportunities (up to 2 years after completing programme up to Cohort 16); Access to Sheffield Y12-13 programme; Access to Sheffield Summer School; and Sutton Trust Summer School. Students do not need to notify Sheffield - academic selectors are already aware of participation. Home fee status required.
